title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and unconditional machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence across analytic number theory, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.1.0 adds: zero-hypothesis differential transcendence over C(x) of the n-th prime OGF ∑_{n>=1} p_n x^n via MediumPNT (completing Pak's Conjecture 2.5 alongside ∑ π(n) x^n; Pak's Conjecture 2.6 for ∑ x^{n^3} is proved separately in pak-cubic-theta, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24492865); Zagier's 2001 formal identity (Theorem 3) from scratch; and unconditional differential transcendence over C(x) and strong differential transcendence over C({x}) (convergent meromorphic germs at 0) of the literal divergent Fishburn OGF ∑_{m>=0} ∏_{j=1}^m (1-(1-x)^j) (settling the open question in Bostan–Di Vizio–Raschel, AJM 2024, §2.2.6), Glaisher's T-number EGF, and the general torus-knot kernel series from sin(ps)sin(qs)/sin(pqs) for all p, q >= 2. All 94 audited declarations depend strictly on standard axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and pass fresh leanchecker replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with the investigation, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization. Independent specialist review is welcome.
